description: This file defines configuration parsing logic for voice chat modes, including data structures and functions to parse JSON configuration objects related to talk mode gateway settings.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Data class representing the configuration state for talk mode gateway, including session key, interrupt flag, and silence timeout.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigParser
classes.description: Object containing methods to parse configuration JSON into TalkModeGatewayConfigState instances.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON object into a TalkModeGatewayConfigState, extracting relevant fields with support for missing or malformed data.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the silence timeout in milliseconds from a JSON object, falling back to default if invalid.
